scope: Sequential pending Website_URL venue checks at audit indices 552–579 (skipping already checked/no-site entries), Croatia, Bosnia, Romania, Slovenia, Slovakia, Greece, Norway, Iceland, Malta, Cyprus
publication: No event import; official source dates are old or outside January 2027, mixed audience, or inaccessible. Q Club third-party January calendar conflicts with official address and lacks men-only darkroom confirmation.

highlights.finding: Oslo Pride 2027 is officially June 16–26, not January.
January 2027 third-party listings conflict with the Q Club's official address and do not establish men-only darkroom eligibility.
Fincken explicitly welcomes everyone regardless of gender/sexuality.

entries.Name: Zagreb Pride
entries.january_findings: Zagreb Pride official English site covers LGBTIQ rights, past marches and 2026 news; no individually dated January 2027 men-only darkroom event. Pride march itself is inclusive public activism.

entries.Name: Sauna Centar Zagreb
entries.january_findings: Official Zagreb Sauna Centar website returned a browser-verification challenge, so an independently dated January 2027 event cannot be checked from this page. Keep for alternate verified source review.

entries.Name: Split Pride
entries.january_findings: Split Pride source returned an anti-bot browser-verification challenge. No January 2027 men-only darkroom event confirmed from this official URL.

entries.Name: The Pride Beach
entries.january_findings: Official Pride Beach Novalja festival homepage lists 26–29 August 2026 LGBTQ+ open beach parties, not January 2027 or men-only darkroom sessions.

entries.Name: BiH Pride March
entries.january_findings: BiH Pride March official site describes an inclusive public human-rights march; annual site navigation includes 2026 archive but no January 2027 men-only darkroom party.

entries.Name: Bucharest Pride
entries.january_findings: Official ACCEPT Romania Bucharest Pride URL returned HTTP 403. No event-specific January 2027 men's darkroom notice verified through this URL.

entries.Name: Q Club
entries.january_findings: Official Q Club Bucharest events page currently displays parties in July 2026 (other fetched version had Oct–Nov 2026), not January 2027. A third-party directory publishes Jan 3/4/10/11 dates with a different address (Bulevardul Carol I 61) versus official Strada Verzișori 20, and describes general nightclub events, not confirmed men-only darkroom. Do not import; hold date/location discrepancies for recheck.

entries.Name: Ljubljana Pride Festival
entries.january_findings: Official Ljubljana Pride Festival site advertises its 2026 festival and historical editions; no January 2027 men-only play party. Inclusive human-rights and cultural festival, not a cruising club.

entries.Name: Klub Tiffany
entries.january_findings: Official Kulturni Center Q / Klub Tiffany homepage displays Aug/Sep 2026 events and queer community activities. Its calendar endpoint timed out, and no January 2027 men-only darkroom event was confirmed.

entries.Name: Rainbow PRIDE Bratislava
entries.january_findings: Official Bratislava Rainbow Pride homepage still promotes 18 July 2026 inclusive public Pride, without eligible January 2027 men-only darkroom event.

entries.Name: Thessaloniki Pride
entries.january_findings: Official Thessaloniki Pride site currently displays festival 15–20 June 2026 and 2026 news. No January 2027 men-only darkroom party.

entries.Name: Enola
entries.january_findings: Official Enola Thessaloniki promotes daily LGBTQ+ nightclub opening and an 'Upcoming Event' heading without dated January 2027 listings; general mixed/inclusive queer club, no confirmed men-only darkroom event.

entries.Name: Oslo Pride
entries.january_findings: Official Oslo Pride homepage explicitly announces 16–26 June 2027, with Pride Park 23 June and parade 26 June; no January 2027 men-only darkroom event.

entries.Name: Bergen Pride
entries.january_findings: Official Bergen Pride page remains focused on 29 May–6 June 2026 rainbow celebrations and 2026 programme, not January 2027 men-only darkroom parties.

entries.Name: Fincken
entries.january_findings: Official Fincken events page describes recurring inclusive queer bar/social/drag programmes and refers visitors to Facebook and Instagram for upcoming dates. Official statement welcomes any gender and orientation; no dated January 2027 men-only darkroom event.

entries.Name: Reykjavík Pride
entries.january_findings: Reykjavík Pride official site timed out. Municipal tourism sources place the inclusive festival in August; published third-party 2027 dates conflict, so no January 2027 men-only darkroom date or festival-specific date is asserted.

entries.Name: Kiki Queer Bar
entries.january_findings: Kiki Reykjavík official domain returned HTTP 403. No individually dated January 2027 men-only darkroom event established from the website.

entries.Name: Malta Pride
entries.january_findings: Official Malta Pride homepage and events section explicitly advertise 4–13 September 2026 and 2026 event calendar; no January 2027 men-only darkroom event.

entries.Name: Gozo Pride
entries.january_findings: Official Gozo Pride site announces Saturday 5 September 2026 Pride Village and 30 August boat party; inclusive public programmes, no January 2027 qualifying men's-only event.

entries.Name: Cyprus Pride
entries.january_findings: Official Accept LGBTI Cyprus URL displays a browser-verification challenge; no January 2027 male-only darkroom event verified. Accept is a community/Pride organisation, not evidence of a cruising event.
